test: Mobile Controls V2 — Portrait Tap Zone + Landscape Gamepad

acceptanceCriteria.AC1_portraitTapZone: PASS — tap 4 regions (UP/LEFT/DOWN/RIGHT) steer correctly; reverse-guard (RIGHT→LEFT) ignored
acceptanceCriteria.AC2_noPauseOnTap: PASS — tap during PLAYING stays PLAYING; pause only via button
acceptanceCriteria.AC3_gamepadLayout: PASS — body.landscape, gamepad LEFT of canvas, start RIGHT, pause-hidden, dpad≥56px, start≥72px
acceptanceCriteria.AC4_dpadControls: PASS — touch D-pad UP/LEFT/DOWN/RIGHT steer; canvas touch=nothing; Start toggles PLAY/PAUSE
acceptanceCriteria.AC5_autoSwitch: PASS — P→L and L→P switch orient, show/hide gamepad, preserve score+state (no reset)
acceptanceCriteria.AC7_HUD: PASS — portrait: topbar+score+pause visible, gamepad/start hidden; landscape: pause hidden (Start takes over)
acceptanceCriteria.AC8_desktop: PASS — no touch → orient=portrait, gamepad/start hidden, Space starts, arrows steer, P pauses
acceptanceCriteria.AC9_noTouchConflict: PASS — canvas touch in landscape during PLAYING = no state/dir change; D-pad uses touchstart+preventDefault
acceptanceCriteria.AC10_v1Superseded: PASS — joystick demoted to swipe-fallback only; tap zone (portrait) + D-pad (landscape) primary

bugsFixed.symptom: Portrait: tapping canvas on MENU/GAME_OVER/PAUSED did nothing — game could not start via touch (cascaded into AC-1/AC-2 failures)
bugsFixed.rootCause: touchEnded() only handled PLAYING+portrait branch; the MENU/GAME_OVER/PAUSED tap-to-action path was missing (regression from the instant-tap refactor)
bugsFixed.fix: index.html touchEnded() — added near-zero-drag → handleAction() branch for non-PLAYING states

bugsFixed.symptom: Desktop (1280x800, no touch) detected as 'landscape' → gamepad/start buttons visible
bugsFixed.rootCause: getOrientation() used only width<height; wide desktops trip landscape mode
bugsFixed.fix: index.html — added isTouchDevice() guard; getOrientation() returns 'portrait' on non-touch devices so mobile controls stay hidden (spec §4.3, AC-8)
